FIELDS.NAME: Guardian Security Solutions
FIELDS.GL CODE: Unarmed security guard services for retail establishments with contents valued under $500,000
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Guardian Security Solutions specializes in providing unarmed security guard services primarily for commercial and retail establishments, focusing on locations with contents valued under $500,000. Our operations are centered on maintaining a secure environment through vigilant surveillance, access control, and customer service. We also offer security consulting services that include risk assessments and security audits, ensuring compliance with local regulations while minimizing exposure to liability. Our team is committed to employing only licensed personnel who are trained to handle various security challenges in a professional and effective manner. Additionally, we operate in accordance with key safety measures, such as ensuring all locations are equipped with monitored alarm systems for high-value contents. Our goal is to deliver reliable and effective security solutions tailored to the specific needs of our clients while adhering to established industry standards.

Our detective and security services operate in locations with contents valued over $500,000, and we monitor security through our team on-site rather than using a central alarm system.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Security Consulting Services, providing risk assessments and security audits without direct involvement in physical security operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred from a theft incident on 02/15/2022, attributed to a lack of monitored central alarm system as required for locations with contents valued over $500,000. Amount of loss estimated at $45,000. Status: Incident reported, under investigation.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $500,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: "Monitored Class B safe, UL Listed, suitable for contents up to $500,000."
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored central alarm system in place for all locations.
